checked_items.en: Scanned the dsh integration surface (extensions/dsh/index.js, bootstrap.js) and shared adapter code (extensions/shared/aegis-bootstrap.ts) for credential-reading behavior: the extension only reads its own skill directory and the user configuration file (~/.config/aegis/config.toml, containing activation_mode and tdd_mode, not credentials); no reads of any sensitive paths such as API keys, tokens, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, or wallet mnemonics were found.

checked_items.en: Network command keywords appearing in test tools and documentation (e.g., the banned command list in the benchmark scoring tool, curl data in test cases) are validation logic for the test framework or documentation examples, not credential reading or exfiltration behavior of the plugin itself.

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展与共享适配代码无任何凭据文件读取，仅读取自身技能目录与 ~/.config/aegis/config.toml 的模式开关；扩展无网络外联调用，不存在凭据读取加外发的组合通道。
evidence.en: The dsh extension and shared adapter code perform no credential file reads; they only read their own skill directory and the mode switches in ~/.config/aegis/config.toml. The extension makes no outbound network calls, so no combined credential-read-plus-exfiltration channel exists.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 dsh 扩展注入模型的引导文案（extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js 经 agent/session-start 与 session/event 事件延迟注入的 using-aegis 技能内容）：为方法包路由契约，声明用户指令优先，无窃取、自改、越权等恶意指令，并标记为插件来源。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the bootstrap text injected into the model by the dsh extension (the using-aegis skill content injected via agent/session-start and session/event events from extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js): it is a method-package routing contract, declares user instructions take precedence, contains no malicious instructions such as stealing, self-modification, or privilege escalation, and is marked as plugin-sourced.

checked_items.zh: 审查了仓库根 AGENTS.md：为面向 AI 开发者的仓库指南，权威次序中用户的当前指令排第一，无指令覆写、系统消息伪装等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the repository-root AGENTS.md: it is a repository guide for AI developers, with the user's current instruction ranking first in the authority order; no injection wording such as instruction overriding or system-message impersonation was found.

checked_items.zh: 审查了全部 23 处模型面指令文件（AGENTS.md 与 22 个 SKILL.md）：全部为方法包工作流定义，含显式模式守卫门与用户指令优先声明，内容纯良性，无凭据读取诱导、安装诱导或授权绕过措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all 23 model-facing instruction files (AGENTS.md and 22 SKILL.md files): all are method-package workflow definitions containing explicit mode guard gates and user-instruction-precedence declarations. The content is benign, with no wording inducing credential reading, installation, or authorization bypass.

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展未注册任何工具，不产生工具描述文本；注入模型的引导文案（extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js 注入的 using-aegis 内容）为路由纪律且声明用户指令优先，无恶意指令。
evidence.en: The dsh extension registers no tools and produces no tool description text. The bootstrap text injected into the model (the using-aegis content injected by extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js) is routing discipline and declares user instructions take precedence; no malicious instructions were found.

evidence.zh: 引导文案与技能文档均未出现诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；update-aegis 技能要求显式用户请求才执行更新。
evidence.en: Neither the bootstrap text nor the skill documentation contains wording that induces installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation. The update-aegis skill requires an explicit user request before performing an update.

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展使用 agent/session-start 与 session/event 事件合法延迟注入自身引导文案并标记为插件来源，未监听 agent/pre-step 事件改写用户消息，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The dsh extension legitimately uses the agent/session-start and session/event events for delayed injection of its own bootstrap text, marked as plugin-sourced. It does not listen to the agent/pre-step event to rewrite user messages, so that scenario is not applicable.
